description: This file implements the MessageDispatcher class and its nested class MessageDispatcherClient, handling client management and event propagation for media key sessions, license requests, renewals, and key status changes.

classes.name: MessageDispatcherClient
classes.description: Nested class within MessageDispatcher that manages individual client instances, registering and deregistering clients upon construction and destruction.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new MessageDispatcherClient instance for a given IMediaKeysClient.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Adds a client to the dispatcher’s client set, protected by a mutex.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes a client from the dispatcher’s client set, protected by a mutex.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Broadcasts a license request event to all registered clients.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Broadcasts a license renewal event to all registered clients.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Broadcasts a key status change event to all registered clients.
